acceptance: Accept only proved operator/norm bounds. Mark the numerical-stability target limited if global contraction/gap does not follow, recording a precise failure and missing inequality. A rigorously rejected proposed majorant is also legitimate.

proposed_not_accepted: There may exist explicit tau0>0 and C with ||R||_w<=C tau^2 for |tau|<=tau0, enough to start a quantitative global scheme. Whether this already yields a numerical gap is a separate obligation.
representation: Finite tensor product over Lambda of the actual separable I1 block spaces with unbounded h_b and product reference Omega. Infinite homogeneous quasi-local interaction estimates, if obtained, do not establish a globally bounded ITP perturbation or a canonical-profile transfer.
required: Prove finite-volume simultaneous rotation preserves the common unbounded domain and has the correct first bounded commutator; do not place unbounded H0 inside an unjustified norm series.

Enumerate or rigorously bound every connected ordered nested commutator and enlarged support at arbitrary order. Derive an explicit convergent scalar majorant for the declared weighted norm, independent of cuboid size.
Provide an actual numerical interval and evaluated constant for an O(tau^2) retained remainder if possible; distinguish its series-validity threshold from a ground-state gap/stability threshold.

Bound the retained first-order diagonal part relative to H0 with full site overlap multiplicity. Test whether the remainder is vacuum-annihilating/pure relative or whether an iterative closure premise is still absent.
Attempt the numerical contraction/gap inference honestly. If not proved, exhibit the exact failed inference or norm/domain obstruction and a justified next candidate, not a guessed source constant.
Read targeted applicable primary proof steps, including Yarotsky hypotheses and whole-dimensional unbounded-domain methods when invoked. Record reading depth and missing constants.

At least one discriminating cross-star or generated-support control and a valid control rejecting deletion of the remainder or local-norm-to-global-gap substitution. Finite spin fixtures are lemma controls, not SU2 physical simulations.
target: Quantify one full finite-volume simultaneous Lie rotation in the homogeneous full-link model, with every overlapping generated support and an explicit volume-independent local interaction remainder; assess whether it closes numerical stability.
